title: Default wallpaper is showed for a second after login, before slideshow starts
line: With a slideshow wallpaper, the desktop no longer flashes the default wallpaper at login before the slideshow image appears.
explanation: In slideshow mode the wallpaper's image comes from the slideshow backend, which stays empty until it has listed every image in the slideshow folders. An empty source makes the media proxy load the default wallpaper package, so the default wallpaper is shown until the folder listing finishes, longer with big folders or slow disks. The slideshow already saves its current slide in the Image config key; the wallpaper now shows that saved slide until the slideshow has its first image.

commits.message:
wallpapers/slideshow: show the last slide while the slideshow loads

At startup the slideshow has no image until it has listed its folders,
and the empty source made it load the default wallpaper meanwhile. The
last slide, which is saved in the config, is now shown until then.

BUG: 490648

patches.diff:
From c7c67ec4309bc92286dc74eb9f249349abfe9285 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:16:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/slideshow: show the last slide while the slideshow
 loads

At startup the slideshow has no image until it has listed its folders,
and the empty source made it load the default wallpaper meanwhile. The
last slide, which is saved in the config, is now shown until then.

BUG: 490648
---
 wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/main.qml | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/main.qml b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/main.qml
index 14aac831f8..374f730bd2 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -70,7 +70,8 @@ WallpaperItem {
 
         source: {
             if (root.pluginName === "org.kde.slideshow") {
-                return imageWallpaper.image;
+                // Keep showing the last slide until the slideshow has found its images
+                return imageWallpaper.image || root.configuration.Image;
             }
             if (root.configuration.PreviewImage !== "null") {
                 return root.configuration.PreviewImage;
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: plasmashell restarted with a slideshow of a red and 20,000 green images; the default wallpaper shows for about a second before the red slide.
After: same moment of the restart; the last slide (red) is shown straight away.
Before: restart video, black gap, default wallpaper, then fade to the red slide.
After: restart video, black gap, then directly the red slide.

review.text: Falling back to root.configuration.Image while imageWallpaper.image is empty in slideshow mode cleanly prevents MediaProxy from loading the default Plasma wallpaper (and dismissing ksplash onto it) during asynchronous folder scanning. The short-circuiting QML expression avoids binding loops once the slideshow populates its image, preserves the default fallback on a first-time slideshow without a saved slide, and is backed by realistic 20,000-image restart testing and passing wallpaper autotests.

reviews.text: Falling back to root.configuration.Image while imageWallpaper.image is empty in slideshow mode cleanly prevents MediaProxy from loading the default Plasma wallpaper (and dismissing ksplash onto it) during asynchronous folder scanning. The short-circuiting QML expression avoids binding loops once the slideshow populates its image, preserves the default fallback on a first-time slideshow without a saved slide, and is backed by realistic 20,000-image restart testing and passing wallpaper autotests.

Correct diagnosis: in slideshow mode the source is empty until the async slide listing finishes, and MediaProxy turns an empty source into the default wallpaper package. The reporters see this as a 1-2 s flash whose length depends on the folder, disk and distro. Falling back to the already-persisted Image key (the last slide, which the backend also uses to resume sequential order) is a minimal fix in the right layer. The || short-circuit means the binding doesn't depend on Image once the slideshow has an image, so there's no loop, and verify reports no QML warnings. The screenshots and videos clearly show the default wallpaper before and the saved slide straight away after. The remaining first-ever-start case (nothing saved yet) is disclosed, and it isn't the login-every-day scenario reported.
